scope: Content reconciliation, not full product migration or a global source-pin update. Deferred rows remain unmet.

changes.reason: Existing Jev CI already removed coverage/line quotas and retains full tests, types, packaged exports and actual containment. Product binary smoke remains deferred until executable packaging exists.
Daemon binary release and exact tested-artifact publication belong to the pending product packaging milestone; do not import legacy release dispatch into the monorepo.
Upstream release history is evidence, not Jev release history. No synthetic Jev1.29 release or package bump.
Version badge and release-prepare instructions describe the upstream package; Jev keeps its own migration and release documentation.
The upstream dependency update is not copied over the independent workspace lock; SDK dependency reconciliation owns matching package changes.
Deleted upstream coverage configuration is already absent from the Jev product; no coverage quota restored.
Use real behavior, isolated hosts and outcome-driven tests. Record executable/wire/binary acceptance below; preserve Jev guarded runner and real containment proof.
Private workspace identity, workspace engine dependency and monorepo build/test/release commands stay authoritative. Source and wire versions remain distinct.
Upstream removes line caps/text rules. Jev already removed arbitrary line gates; retain real import, package and containment checks rather than copy source-scraping rules.
Deleted upstream per-push changelog gate was never a daemon-product gate here; do not restore it.
Use the current monorepo workflows and their functional release/containment checks; standalone daemon workflow template is not imported.
Deleted upstream coverage quota was never ported into the product; do not restore it.
Carry streaming fixture plus stored assistant-reply marker into the compiled-daemon proof when a real executable exists. Provider-request count alone is insufficient.
Version-stamp/changelog generation must be reconciled with the monorepo release model at product packaging; no standalone release side effects added now.
Jev product uses its owned guarded runner with recursive discovery and isolated homes. Upstream changed-selection optimization is not required to preserve runtime behavior.
Only comments about obsolete coverage invocations changed; scratch prefixes and cleanup behavior are unchanged. Jev retains its reviewed owned-temp cleanup and evidence-preservation rules.
The changed-selection flag accompanies the upstream standalone runner; do not replace Jev runner semantics.
The new wrfcFixEngine field is intentionally represented by Jev contractRunner and its composed store, not a second legacy engine.

Upstream now owns WRFC planned-fix disposal. Jev owns its sole contract composition immediately, on rollback, and at shutdown; the added real-graph test proves cancellation, pending-store flush and detached admission.
Removed source-text console-location test; no corresponding product test was imported.
Deleted source-scraping dispatch test was not ported. Its real-entrypoint replacement is now mapped to products/daemon/src/test/cli/entrypoint.test.ts.

Adapted to products/daemon/src/test/cli/entrypoint.test.ts against the real emitted dispatcher and installed package-bin links: package version, misspelled command with exit 2 and help, sessions help, exact Unknown command: doctor, and send behind --daemon-home refusing before configuration. Every child exit has an owned deadline and bounded kill/reap cleanup; an interrupted held-poll child proves timeout cleanup. Native binary and release acceptance remain separate.

Adapted to products/daemon/src/test/daemon/daemon-wire.test.ts against the real configured graph: wrong/missing-token WebSocket refusal, exact Last-Event-ID replay, and hosted streaming turn/detach/reattach with saved reply text. Inbox, metadata and Jev inputs are explicit offline fixtures; production default intake and binary proof remain separate.
The removed real gh invocation was not imported; future tests must inject external CI boundaries and exercise actual local handlers.
Engine daemon-remote-process-runner test now proves timeout/nonzero child exit under a test ceiling rather than an elapsed-time speed assertion; retains descendant and pipe regressions.

Use an absolute-path Bun fixture with an invocation marker and delayed active output: omitted timeout changes the refusal outcome independently of the test hang ceiling. Retain Jev dry-run, ownership and failure receipts. Cumulative-deadline stub path was already explicit.
Upstream deletes package-pin/source-location assertions. Jev uses workspace imports and actual package/export checks; no test-only dependency pin copy.
WRFC fixWorkstreamRunner helper is retired by the one-contract-runner design; no legacy test composition added.
Deleted source-scraping composition pins were not imported; real product boot, rollback and ownership tests stay.
Deleted source-text ownership checks were not imported. Existing real runtime/store tests remain; exported path behavior stays in canonical engine.
Deleted source-text and defined-only parity tests were not imported; do not treat missing filler as migration failure.
Deleted source-text wiring test was not imported; actual prompt/containment behavior belongs to existing engine and future product wire tests.
Comment-only cleanup of the upstream fixture; no production delta. Canonical engine hosted-session posture tests already run.

The source-scraping assertions are retired. Merged PR30 / THE65 (ef9baadd) replaces their intended authority guarantee with real first/queued-turn provider probes: only explicit ownerChannels grants permit profile reads or acknowledgments. See docs/audit/sdk-channel-capabilities.md. Full daemon executable coverage remains separate.
Upstream removes defined/source-text checks; Jev already has real broker disposition/trust regressions instead. Preserve explicit operator authority.
Adapt lifecycle intent to real Jev contract owner: held reading cancelled, delayed store flushed, post-close agent admission refused. No WRFC surface restored.
Test actual stamping behavior with the future chosen product release implementation, not the unused upstream script.
Deleted standalone source-text workflow expectations were not imported; retain only meaningful monorepo release safety proof.
Existing product cli/version-identity tests already import copied real version source beside own/foreign manifests and check rendered package version.
Jev already trusts only @goodvibes-jev/daemon manifest identity. Keep its actual private1.28.25 package version/fallback until product release, not upstream1.29.0.
Upstream release sync no longer runs removed style/coverage gates. Reconcile toolchain at actual Jev executable packaging; no standalone toolchain adopted.
